name: stepfun-asr
description: >- Transcribes Chinese/English audio with StepFun's stepaudio-3-asr-max via its SSE endpoint (not /v1/audio/transcriptions) — one call handles long-form audio with no chunking. Use when migrating from step-asr/stepaudio-2.5-asr, or hitting the misleading "model not supported" error (actually wrong endpoint). Triggers on 阶跃 ASR, 语音识别. Not for TTS with the sibling model (use stepfun-tts).
author: daymade
